## About
Bargain Auto & Truck Repairs is a family and locally owned shop on Main Street in South Bound Brook. We're a licensed repair, lube and tune center, and our mechanics are ASE Certified.
Bring in your car or truck and we'll find the problem, tell you what it is, and fix it. We answer your questions, even the complicated ones, and we'll give you a straight answer on what it needs.
Need a quick fix? We do same day service. Stop by or call ahead to schedule an appointment, and we'll help you get back on the road.

## Services
- Diagnostics: Check engine, air bag or ABS light on? We'll pinpoint the problem in your car or truck before it turns into a costly one.
- Electrical, brake and transmission diagnostics: We track down electrical, brake system and transmission problems so you know what's actually wrong.
- Oil Changes: Stop in for an oil change and we'll check the car over while it's here.
- Tune Ups: Regular tune ups to keep your car running smooth.
- Foreign & Domestic Auto Repair: We work on foreign and domestic cars and trucks.
- Same day services: For when you need a quick fix and can't be without your car.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer same day service?
A: Yes. We do same day services for folks who need a quick fix.

Q: Should I make an appointment?
A: Calling ahead is best. Give us a call to schedule, or stop by the shop.

Q: Are you open Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We repair both foreign and domestic cars and trucks.
